# Second River Games

> Second River Games is an independent studio of experienced game developers in Cambridge, UK, making its own games and building Iteration Room (working title), a production studio for game makers. The creator makes the creative decisions, and Iteration Room does the production work inside the game engine they already use, keeping the game true to what they had in mind. We work on both sides: our own games, and the technology to make them.

Second River Games Ltd is a UK-registered independent game studio founded by Bulut Karakaya and Duygu Cakmak, two developers with nearly two decades of shared game industry experience. Iteration Room starts each game from a playable foundation (a world, characters and systems that already work together), turns the creator's direction into changes in the game, checks every change against their design and tests it. It is built for small professional teams first (small studios and experienced developers going independent), then more independent developers, and later anyone with a good game idea. The studio's first foundation is Village of Whispers, a living village whose people remember and act on what they hear; its first game built from it is Once Upon a Well, a fairy-tale village where the player's answers decide how each tale ends.
